name: proxmox-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Proxmox VE and Proxmox Datacenter Manager.
long_description: Connect Claude to your [Proxmox](https://www.proxmox.com) infrastructure. All 993 API endpoints (675 Proxmox VE + 318 Proxmox Datacenter Manager) behind 6 catalog-backed list/describe/call tools. Reads execute by default; writes are blocked unless enabled via the write-gate settings, and destructive operations additionally require confirm:true per call. Configure one or both surfaces.

pve_host.title: Proxmox VE Host
pve_host.description: PVE hostname, for example pve.example.com (expands to https://<host>:8006/api2/json). Both surfaces are optional: configure PVE, PDM, or both.

pve_base_url.title: Proxmox VE Base URL
pve_base_url.description: Full PVE API base URL, for example https://pve.example.com:8006/api2/json. Overrides the host field when set; leave blank otherwise.

pve_token_id.title: PVE API Token ID
pve_token_id.description: For example root@pam!mcp. Create one in PVE under Datacenter > Permissions > API Tokens.

pve_token_secret.title: PVE API Token Secret
pve_token_secret.description: The token secret UUID shown once at token creation.

pve_auth_scheme.title: PVE Auth Scheme
pve_auth_scheme.description: Auth header scheme for PVE. Leave the default unless auth fails.

pve_auth_sep.title: PVE Auth Separator
pve_auth_sep.description: Separator between token id and secret in the auth header. Leave the default unless auth fails.

pve_tls_reject_unauthorized.title: PVE TLS Verification
pve_tls_reject_unauthorized.description: Set to false to accept Proxmox's default self-signed certificate; true verifies the TLS certificate.

pve_allow_writes.title: PVE Allow Writes
pve_allow_writes.description: Set to true to enable write operations (POST/PUT/DELETE) on the PVE surface. Read-only by default.

pdm_host.title: Proxmox Datacenter Manager Host
pdm_host.description: PDM hostname, for example pdm.example.com (expands to https://<host>:8443/api2/json). Optional: leave blank if you only use PVE.

pdm_base_url.title: PDM Base URL
pdm_base_url.description: Full PDM API base URL, for example https://pdm.example.com:8443/api2/json. Overrides the host field when set; leave blank otherwise.

pdm_token_secret.title: PDM API Token Secret
pdm_token_secret.description: The token secret shown once at token creation.

pdm_auth_scheme.title: PDM Auth Scheme
pdm_auth_scheme.description: Auth header scheme for PDM. PDM is newer and its scheme may differ; adjust if auth fails.

pdm_auth_sep.title: PDM Auth Separator
pdm_auth_sep.description: Separator between token id and secret in the auth header. Leave the default unless auth fails.

pdm_tls_reject_unauthorized.title: PDM TLS Verification
pdm_tls_reject_unauthorized.description: Set to false to accept a self-signed certificate; true verifies the TLS certificate.

pdm_allow_writes.title: PDM Allow Writes
pdm_allow_writes.description: Set to true to enable write operations (POST/PUT/DELETE) on the PDM surface. Read-only by default.

proxmox_allow_writes.title: Allow Writes (All Surfaces)
proxmox_allow_writes.description: Set to true to enable write operations on both surfaces at once. Read-only by default. Destructive operations still require confirm:true per call.

tools.name: pve_list_endpoints
tools.description: Discover Proxmox VE endpoints by category, resource, method, or search

tools.name: pve_describe_endpoint
tools.description: Full param + response spec for one PVE endpoint

tools.name: pve_call_endpoint
tools.description: Validate, write-gate, and execute a PVE API call

tools.name: pdm_describe_endpoint
tools.description: Full param + response spec for one PDM endpoint

tools.name: pdm_call_endpoint
tools.description: Validate, write-gate, and execute a PDM API call
